profile.headline: Web Developer at Two Barrels
profile.summary:
For years I've been tinkering with web design and development as a hobby. Until recently, it was only something to keep me sane while I earned degrees in accounting and computer information systems. Fast-forward a few years, and I am now making a career out of my passion for web design and development.



I've put countless hours into studying and implementing time-tested languages and build tools, while following best-practices for performance, security, and WCAG 2.0 accessibility. I've been learning as much as possible while in school and through my work, and am eager to transition to full-time web development as soon as I graduate.


As of December 2018, I have real-world experience using HTML5, CSS, PHP, and JavaScript. I've worked with several libraries/frameworks/tools in this time: JavaScript, jQuery, SASS/SCSS, WordPress, Node.js, Gulp, Webpack, Shopify, Ruby/Rails, Laravel, WAMP, LAMPP, and Apache.

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description: Designing accessible, secure, high-performance websites for clients using modern best-practices.

positions.title: Freelance Writer
positions.description:
Write search engine/keyword-friendly content for a wide array of companies for their blogs, website content, and any other use they may have.

Thoroughly research any related subjects required to write accurate, meaningful content.

Use best practices for search engine optimization (SEO) to increase website ranking in search engines.

positions.title: Social Media Relations & Data Analysis
positions.description:
While they looked to hire a Florida resident full-time, I created engaging content for their social media accounts, increasing website traffic and conversions.

Managed the Twitter and Pinterest accounts for the company
-Planning and posting content on a daily basis
-Reaching out to potential customers and interacting with them
-Responding to any communications posted on the social media profiles of the company

Analyzed the data metrics for the Twitter and Pinterest accounts
-Looked for changes and trends in the interactions with the company's social media profiles. 
-Analyzed data for the profiles, including: views, follows, retweets, repins, follows, comments, clickthroughs, and more.
-Used the data to make measurable changes in social media interactions, discovering what types of posts and pins were popular and generated the most activity.

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
Coordinate with CEO and COO over daily functions of the company including anything from market research, organization, brainstorming, networking, and website design.

Assist in the growth and development of Hydro Cigs by organizing and implementing ideas and managing online PR Campaigns.

Facilitate the communication throughout the company by acting as the link between different departments and people within the company.

positions.title: Head of Public Relations & Partner
positions.description:
Trusted business adviser with responsibilities such as: recommending courses of action, brainstorming new and innovative ideas, and assisting the owner in developing business plans and future features. 

Interact with our users and update them with any news or upcoming features.

Comment and respond to any messages or forum posts users make directed towards the company.

honors.title: Delegate for the International Scholar Laureate Program (ISLP) on Business & Entrepreneurship
honors.description: I was selected as one of the delegates for Business & Entrepreneurship with the International Scholar Laureate Program (ISLP). I had the opportunity to go to either China or Australia to meet with the business leaders that are developing the countries into economic powerhouses and learn from them.
